comparisons.ourTranslation: I adore You, my God, and love You with all my heart.

comparisons.note: Hagan-related online Q984 prescribes repeating morning prayers and examination; the distinct short 1905 printed evening appendix is not present. Do not recast online Q984 as the original evening appendix.
The 1913 French revised sequence includes petitions and order changes not present in the 1905 appendix. English Hagan-related Q974 comparison cannot certify this edition.

conclusion: Hagan is valuable for checking English register and broad 1905 practice meaning, but the online derivative cannot authorize the exact wording of the 1914 printing or override the 1905 Italian text. No user-visible Italian language mode.
